description: Tallow Fen bestiary wave 2 — Tallow Hound + Bog Tithe pose/angle variations for the style LoRA dataset. Anti-miss negatives: no literal hanging-lantern prop (wave-1 literalized the style descriptor's lantern LIGHT into a prop), hound is peat-flesh with exposed ribs, not a full skeleton. Prompts derived from canon/tallow-fen-canon.md.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, a single warm lantern light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

defaults.negative: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, chibi, cute, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth CG, multiple creatures, human person, modern gear, metal plate armor, gun, text, watermark, frame, border, signature, hanging lantern, carried lantern, lantern on a chain, lantern prop, full skeleton, skeletal dog, bare bones everywhere
